title: Page 150
transc:
C. G. Sholes  Wash'n Aug 7th 1864 1030 Pm 
Growl Aug Plunder Reliance For Kidnap
Shelby Wash burn has been directed
to send you all the whisky
he can possibly spare from his
Polka youth Italy awful hot here


Capt W. G. Fuller  Wash'n Aug 7th 1864
Hang Aug Downing Reliance For Oyster Tulip
It is important that the Salems of
your Princeton that can possibly be spared
should be imm'y sent to Fortune Spit
Bishop yawl Cupid acknowledge recpt of this


930 PM
Thayer Phila  Wash D. C. Aug 10. 1864
Washn Aug 10. 9. 30.
P. M for Chas Gilpin
U S Dist Atty Phila
Strictly Confidential - Spare no
means to catch Keith who
purchased the locomotives ---- His
capture is vastly important I
know him He is the
rebel agent in Halifax ----
He is worth more to
us than you can imagine
signed Edwin M Stanton Secy
